thesis:
This run focused on leveraging the Quality Matrix's top picks, emphasizing strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. We successfully opened long positions on three top picks:

- **A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V)**: Exceptional gold grade at 93.3 g/t (≥45 g/t) and moderate drill program type.
- **Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX)**: Strong copper grade at 2.2% (1.4–5%) and moderate drill program type.
- **Endeavour Mining (EDV.L)**: Exceptional gold grade at 278 g/t (≥45 g/t) and moderate drill program type.

No shorts were opened this run due to the absence of concrete bearish headlines paired with Red-Flag signals.
